hypothesis_or_artifact: HFExperiment H-F (12-1 cross-sectional momentum, forward shadow series) as carried by the note; the "eight to eleven years" horizon that makes it a power case.

claim_quote: Its own registration priced the forward version at 2,061 trading days to clear zero and 2,852 to clear the cost hurdle. Eight to eleven years.
evidence_summary: The 2,061/2,852-day figures are explicitly conditional on a frozen confidence sequence (SOURCES.md:142; identical text in rplimits/cases.py:269-273). Inputs quoted in the repository: excess 27.99 bp/day against daily noise near 418 bp implied by 66.4 percent annualized tracking error (SOURCES.md:130); n = one 2.55-year holdout with zero forward shadow observations (SOURCES.md:138); z 1.668 against a corrected 2.50 bar (SOURCES.md:134). Backing the boundary out of the two crossings: 27.99*sqrt(2061)/418.3 = 3.038 and (27.99-4.07)*sqrt(2852)/418.3 = 3.054, so the frozen sequence is about 3.05 standard errors wide against 1.645 one-sided and 1.96 two-sided fixed-N. Under the note's own "mean holds" convention the identical series clears zero at 604 trading days (2.40 y) one-sided or 858 (3.40 y) two-sided, and clears the 4.07 bp hurdle at 827 or 1,175 days: the sequence costs a factor 2061/604 = 3.41 in sample. Even at 80 percent power one-sided a fixed-N design needs 1,381/1,891 days (5.5/7.5 y), still short of 2,061/2,852. Separately the inherited 2.50 bar is exactly the one-sided Bonferroni bar for eight hypotheses (Phi-inverse(1-0.05/8) = 2.498), which a single pre-registered forward hypothesis does not carry; z 1.668 already clears the uncorrected one-sided 5 percent bar at p = 0.0477.
recomputation: Daily sd = 0.664/sqrt(252) = 418.3 bp. Implied confidence-sequence multiplier mu*sqrt(N)/sd = 3.038 (N=2061) and 3.054 (N=2852). Fixed-N N = (z*sd/mu)^2: one-sided 5 percent 604 / 827 d; two-sided 5 percent 858 / 1,175 d; at the 2.50 bar 1,396 / 1,911 d; at 80 percent power one-sided 1,381 / 1,891 d. Sanity check: z over the 2.55-y holdout (643 sessions) = 27.99*sqrt(643)/418.3 = 1.697 against the quoted 1.668. Script scratchpad/work/agentA-rpl-consolidate/verify.py section 1. evidence_summary: A minimum detectable effect is the effect at which a test reaches its design power, not a detection cliff. The margin is 0.0512 - 0.05 = 0.0012, i.e. 2.4 percent of the band top. Inputs quoted here: realized daily contrast sd 0.36339 against a registered assumption of at most 0.2626 (SOURCES.md:38); n = 415 stored daily rankings of 432 eligible window days, 404 evaluable, 125.6 independent-equivalent after the 3.4 variance inflation (SOURCES.md:42); accrual about 21 trading days a month (SOURCES.md:46). Also (0.0512/0.05)^2 - 1 = 4.86 percent, so about 20 more evaluable days on the 404 - one month of the quoted accrual - would have put the realized MDE inside the band.
